fact: The Global Fund's Office of the Inspector General reported on 22 April 2024 that the Global Fund has invested US$21 million since GC4 in Malawi's Health Management Information System, whose national system (the DHIS2 platform) is nonetheless fully used only by the malaria and TB programmes for three indicators; Mobile DHIS2 had been introduced in 15 districts with over 2,000 tablets procured.
title: Audit Report: Global Fund Grants in Malawi (GF-OIG-24-007)
publisher: The Global Fund, Office of the Inspector General
